basic_details.job_title: DLSA Dindigul Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 30 Para Legal Volunteers Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Legal Services Authority, Dindigul (Dindigul Mavatta Sattappanigal Aanaikkuzhu), has invited applications from residents of eight towns to serve as 30 Para Legal Volunteers with the District and Taluk Legal Services Committees. The completed application form, with copies of documents, must reach The Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Alternative Dispute Resolution Centre, Opposite Combined Court Complex, Dindigul 624 004, by post or in person. It must arrive on or before 9 December 2026, 5.30 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified on the website

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Dindigul
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Dindigul, works from the Combined Court Complex in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. The authority is headed by the Chairman / Principal District Judge, who signed this notice. The Para Legal Volunteers selected under this notice will serve the District / Taluk Legal Services Committees functioning in Dindigul, Palani, Vedasandur, Oddanchatram, Natham, Kodaikanal, Athoor and Gujiliamparai.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by post or by hand only. The address printed in the notice is: The Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Alternative Dispute Resolution Centre, Opposite Combined Court Complex, Dindigul 624 004. Download only the application form attached to the notice. The notice does not allow any other format. Fill in the form clearly and affix a photograph in the box marked "PHOTO". Tick the town where you are willing to work as a Para Legal Volunteer in item 15 of the form. Attach copies of the documents that support the details you give in the form. Send the form by post, or hand it in at the office on an office working day. Make sure it reaches the office on or before 9 December 2026, 5.30 PM. The application form (in Tamil and English) asks for the following details: Name (in capital letters), sex, age and father's / husband's name Educational qualifications and technical qualifications Community / caste and religion Office address, residential address, occupation, telephone number, mobile number and e-mail address Whether you have already worked as a PLV, and if so, details of the service rendered Full details of any criminal, property-related or other court case that is pending or has been decided against you The form ends with date, place (Dindigul) and signature. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are 30 Para Legal Volunteer vacancies across eight towns. The notice gives the following break-up by place: The notice invites the following persons to apply. Applicants must belong to the town they apply for. Teachers (retired) Retired government employees and senior citizens Students pursuing post-graduation in social work, and their teachers Anganwadi workers Doctors / health experts Students and law college students (until they enrol as advocates) Members of non-political, non-governmental social service organisations and clubs Members of women's groups, Maitri Sangams and self-help groups, including the poor Educated prisoners serving long-term sentences in prison Persons whom the District / Taluk Legal Services consider suitable for Para Legal Volunteer work Educational qualification: Must have passed the school final class (10th standard). Must also have broad comprehension ability. Other qualities: Must hold to basic human qualities: compassion, understanding of others' feelings and unblemished integrity. Voluntary service: Must render voluntary service without expecting any monetary benefit or income from the work. Commitment: Must have the commitment and sensitivity to uplift the weaker sections and the poor of society. Age: Must be above 18 years. The notice does not give an upper age limit or a cut-off date for age. Residence: Must belong to the town for which the application is made. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions. An honorarium of Rs.750/- per day will be paid for the days on which the volunteer works. The term of service is one year from the date of selection. Para Legal Volunteer service is not a permanent job. Volunteers cannot claim a right to regularisation.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of the documents for the details given in the application form (item 19 of the form asks whether these copies are attached) Photograph affixed on the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an interview. The date of the interview will be announced later through the website https://dindigul.dcourts.gov.in/ . The notice does not describe any other selection stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many Para Legal Volunteer vacancies are there in DLSA Dindigul Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 vacancies: Dindigul 10, Palani 3, Vedasandur 3, Oddanchatram 2, Natham 3, Athoor 3, Kodaikanal 3 and Gujiliamparai 3.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Dindigul Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office on or before 9 December 2026, 5.30 PM, on office working days.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for a Para Legal Volunteer in Dindigul?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the school final class (10th standard) and must have broad comprehension ability.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DLSA Dindigul Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Applicants must be above 18 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. How much is the Para Legal Volunteer honorarium?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs.750/- per day for the days on which the volunteer works.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DLSA Dindigul Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the attached application form, enclose copies of documents, and send it by post or in person. Address it to The Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Alternative Dispute Resolution Centre, Opposite Combined Court Complex, Dindigul 624 004.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: The notice mentions an interview. Its date will be announced later on https://dindigul.dcourts.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Para Legal Volunteer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The service is for one year from the date of selection, it is not a permanent job, and volunteers cannot claim a right to regularisation.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for a town other than my own?
faq.answer: No. Applicants must belong to the town they apply for, and they mark that town on the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Can law students apply as Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Yes. Students and law college students may apply until they enrol as advocates.
